info.title: anthropic
info.description: Anthropic Messages API for Claude AI interactions and agent tool use

post.summary: Create a message with optional tool use for agent interactions
post.description: Create a message with optional tool use for agent interactions

200.description:
Successful response

application/json: returned when `stream` is false or omitted

text/event-stream: returned when `stream` is true

success.note: returned when `stream` is false or omitted

post.summary: Count tokens in a message before sending
post.description: Count tokens in a message before sending

get.summary: Get information about a specific model
get.description: Get information about a specific model

CreateMessageBody.title: CreateMessageBody
CreateMessageBody.description: Request body for the Create Message endpoint (POST /v1/messages).

max_tokens.description:
Maximum tokens to generate.

Must be less than the model's maximum output limit.

messages.description:
Conversation messages.

Messages alternate between user and assistant roles.

system.description: System prompt providing context and instructions.

temperature.description:
Sampling temperature (0.0-1.0).

Lower values are more deterministic.

tool_choice.description: How to select tools for use.

tools.description: Tools available for the model to use.

CacheControl.description:
Cache control settings for prompt caching.

Prompt caching reduces costs by up to 90% for repeated context.

ttl.description:
Time-to-live for the cache entry.

Valid values: "5m" (default), "1h"

ContentBlock.title: ContentBlock
ContentBlock.description:
Content block for messages.

Messages contain an array of content blocks that can include text,
images, documents, tool use requests, and tool results.

oneOf.description: Text content.

cache_control.description: Optional cache control for prompt caching.

oneOf.description: Image content.

cache_control.description: Optional cache control for prompt caching.

oneOf.description: Document content (PDF, text files).

cache_control.description: Optional cache control for prompt caching.

oneOf.description:
Tool use request from the assistant.

When the model wants to use a tool, it returns this content block.
Execute the tool and return a `ToolResult` block in the next message.

id.description: Unique identifier for this tool use.

name.description: Name of the tool to execute.

oneOf.description:
Result from a tool execution.

Include this in a user message after executing a tool requested
by the assistant.

content.description: The result content (string or nested content blocks).

is_error.description: Whether the tool execution resulted in an error.

tool_use_id.description: The tool_use_id from the corresponding ToolUse block.

oneOf.description:
Extended thinking block (response only).

Contains the model's internal reasoning when extended thinking is enabled.
Base64-encoded document data.
URL reference to a document.
Plain text content.
Base64-encoded image data.
URL reference to an image.

content.description:
Content blocks making up the message.

For simple text messages, use a single TextBlock.
For multimodal or tool interactions, use multiple blocks.

role.description: The role of the message author.

MessageRole.description: The role of a message in the conversation.

oneOf.description: A message from the user.
A message from the assistant.

user_id.description:
External user identifier for abuse detection.

Should be a UUID or hash, not raw identifiable information.

ServiceTier.description: Service tier selection for the request.

oneOf.description: Automatically select the appropriate tier.
Use only standard capacity (no priority queue).
Text system prompt.

SystemPrompt.description:
System prompt for the conversation.

Can be a simple string or an array of content blocks.

anyOf.description: Structured system prompt with cache control.

ThinkingConfig.description:
Configuration for extended thinking.

Extended thinking allows the model to reason internally before responding,
improving accuracy on complex tasks.

budget_tokens.description:
Token budget for thinking (minimum 1024).

Only used when type is "enabled".

oneOf.description: Extended thinking is enabled.
Extended thinking is disabled.

Tool.title: Tool
Tool.description:
A tool definition for the model to use.

Tools are defined using JSON Schema for the input parameters.

cache_control.description: Optional cache control for the tool definition.

description.description:
Human-readable description of what the tool does.

Include when and how to use the tool. Be specific about trigger conditions.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema defining the input parameters.

name.description:
Unique name for the tool.

Must match the pattern `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$`.

ToolChoice.description: How the model should choose which tools to use.

oneOf.description: Let the model decide whether to use tools.
Model must use at least one tool.
Model must use the specified tool.
Model should not use any tools.

ToolResultContent.description:
Content for a tool result.

Can be a simple string or an array of content blocks for rich results.

CountTokensBody.title: CountTokensBody
CountTokensBody.description: Request body for the Count Tokens endpoint (POST /v1/messages/count_tokens).

tools.description: Tools to include in token count.

MessageResponse.title: MessageResponse
MessageResponse.description: Response from the Create Message endpoint.

content.description:
Content blocks in the response.

May contain text, tool_use, and thinking blocks.

stop_sequence.description: The stop sequence that was matched, if any.

oneOf.description: Natural end of the response.
Reached the max_tokens limit.
Hit a custom stop sequence.
Model wants to use a tool (continue the agent loop).
Model paused for user input.
Model refused to generate content.

service_tier.description: Service tier used for this request.

CountTokensResponse.title: CountTokensResponse
CountTokensResponse.description: Response from the Count Tokens endpoint.

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Tokens that would be written to cache.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Tokens that would be read from cache.

ListModelsResponse.title: ListModelsResponse
ListModelsResponse.description: Response from the List Models endpoint.

first_id.description: First ID in the list (for backward pagination).

last_id.description: Last ID in the list (for forward pagination).

created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime of when the model was released.

MessageStreamEvent.title: MessageStreamEvent
MessageStreamEvent.description: One event of a streamed Create Message reply.

oneOf.description: Opens the stream with a message whose `content` is empty.
Opens the content block at `index` of the final message.

content_block.description: The block's initial, usually empty, state.

index.description: Position of the block in the final message's `content`.

oneOf.description: An incremental update to the content block at `index`.

index.description: Position of the block in the final message's `content`.

oneOf.description: Closes the content block at `index`.

index.description: Position of the block in the final message's `content`.

oneOf.description: Top-level changes to the final message.

usage.description: Cumulative token counts; omitted by some streams.

oneOf.description: The final event; the stream's declared terminator.
Keep-alive; may appear any number of times.
An error delivered inside the stream, such as `overloaded_error`.

ContentBlockDelta.title: ContentBlockDelta
ContentBlockDelta.description: The update carried by a `content_block_delta` event.

oneOf.description: Text to append to a `text` block.

A fragment of a `tool_use` block's `input`; fragments concatenate to
JSON only once the block stops.
Text to append to a `thinking` block.
The `thinking` block's signature, sent just before the block stops.

stop_sequence.description: The stop sequence that was matched, if any.

StreamErrorDetail.description: The body of an in-stream `error` event.

StreamMessage.description:
The message carried by `message_start`.

Unlike [`super::MessageResponse`], `stop_reason` is null until a later
`message_delta`, and `usage` may be omitted.

stop_sequence.description: The stop sequence that was matched, if any.
